hero.title: Physical AI for industrial sites, Manager Choi AI for offices
hero.lead: Different worksites require different judgments. DevFirm approaches them through two axes.

axes.name: Physical AI
axes.desc: It turns worksites read by cameras and sensors into judgments people can use.

axes.name: Manager Choi AI
axes.desc: It handles repetitive work such as reading documents, organizing them, and writing reports.

agentsSection.title: Six industries, six kinds of judgment
agentsSection.lead: Industry-specific judgment criteria are placed on the same foundation. The agent speaks in the language of the worksite.

process.title: Start in four steps
steps: Assess current state and check data

items.q: Can we start if our data is not organized?
items.a: Most sites are like that. That is why the first step is a data check. We first confirm what is possible with what is already being accumulated, then create collection paths for what is missing.
It depends on the site and the judgment items. For that reason, we set a pilot period before contracting and measure with real data. Target figures are set together after reviewing the results.

items.q: Do we need to change our existing system?
items.a: In most cases, no. It connects by reading data from the existing system and returning results. If replacement is needed, we explain the reason first.
DevFirm handles the initial stage. Once the judgment criteria stabilize, we hand it over to the person in charge. Continued outsourced operation is also possible.

cta.title: We first decide what judgment to automate
cta.desc: Tell us what judgments people are repeating at your current site.

items.title: Once it passes, it is hard to find

seo.title: DocASI Catalog — Document Automation by Task
seo.description: Browse DocASI document packs by task to read and structure contracts, tax invoices, meeting minutes, tender notices, and site reports.

hero.title: Upload a document. Move work forward.
hero.lead: We do more than read documents. We find the needed details, compare them, and pass them on in a form that can start the next task.

catalog.title: Choose the documents you handle now
catalog.lead: A document pack defines a task's input formats, extracted fields, and outputs for the next system as one unit.

empty.title: No document packs match
empty.body: Try a shorter search or select another work area.

packs.title: Review Key Contract Clauses
packs.summary: Find the contract term, amount, renewal, termination, and damages clauses and organize them into a review checklist.

packs.title: Match Tax Invoices & Transaction Statements
packs.summary: Read supply amounts, taxes, items, and counterparties, then mark differences from purchase orders and receiving records.

packs.title: Organize Expense Requests & Receipts
packs.summary: Pair each receipt with its expense request and standardize the account, merchant, date, and amount.

packs.title: Structure Resumes & Career Histories
packs.summary: Organize experience, skills, projects, and education from different applicant formats using the same criteria.

packs.title: Extract Action Items from Meeting Minutes
packs.summary: Find decisions, assignees, deadlines, and pending items, then turn them into a follow-up task list.

packs.title: Analyze Tender Notices & RFPs
packs.summary: Find eligibility, required documents, evaluation criteria, and dates to create a proposal preparation checklist.

packs.title: Organize Daily Construction Reports
packs.summary: Read work types, personnel, equipment, progress, and notable issues, then combine them into a daily status report for each site.

packs.title: Read Test Reports & Quality Documents
packs.summary: Structure test items, standard values, measured values, and results, then gather cases that fall outside specifications.

workflow.title: Results feed the next task
workflow.lead: We first set the reading criteria for each document and the points people need to review. Then we match the output format to existing work tools.

steps.title: Collect Documents
steps.desc: Receive originals and metadata together from email, folders, and work systems.

steps.title: Extract Fields
steps.desc: Find the required values and their source locations according to the document pack's field definitions.

steps.title: Review & Compare
steps.desc: Gather only exceptions and uncertain items for people to review.

steps.title: Connect Workflows
steps.desc: Pass results to the next system and responsible people through XLSX, CSV, JSON, or an API.

items.title: Keep the original and its source
items.desc: We keep each extracted value linked to the document and location it came from.

items.title: Make exceptions visible
items.desc: We do not automatically finalize ambiguous judgments or conflicting values. We send them for review.

items.title: Fit existing workflows
items.desc: We adapt to the forms and systems already in use, so people do not have to learn another tool.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CMNYX Co., Ltd. (hereinafter the "Company") values users' personal information and complies with relevant laws and regulations. This policy applies to the website operated by the Company.

sections.title: 1. Personal Information Items Collected
body: The Company collects personal information only through the inquiry and course application forms on the website.
Contact Us: name, email, contact number (optional), company or affiliation (optional), inquiry content
Course application: name, email, contact number, desired course, experience level, reason for applying
The Company does not use analytics tools or advertising cookies that track visitor behavior. Therefore, personal information is not collected merely by using the website.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of Collection and Use
body: Responding to inquiries and conducting consultations
Receiving course applications, assigning courses, and providing guidance

sections.title: 3. Retention and Use Period
body: Inquiry information: retained for 3 years after processing is completed and destroyed without delay.
Course application information: retained for 1 year after consultation ends and destroyed without delay.
If the data subject requests destruction, the information is destroyed immediately.

sections.title: 4. Provision to Third Parties and Processing Entrustment
body: The Company does not provide users' personal information to third parties.
However, the Company uses an email sending service to deliver inquiry content to the person in charge, and the content entered is transmitted in this process.

sections.title: 5. Rights of Data Subjects
body: Users may request access to, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time.
Requests may be submitted to contact@devfirm.co or 02-2058-0680, and the Company will take action without delay.

sections.title: 6. Personal Information Protection Officer
body: CMNYX Co., Ltd. Business Support Department
Email: contact@devfirm.co

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
body: If this policy changes, the Company will announce the changes and effective date through the website.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms set forth the conditions for use of the website operated by CMNYX Co., Ltd. (hereinafter the "Company").

sections.title: 1. Purpose
body: These Terms define the rights, obligations, and responsibilities of the Company and users regarding use of the website service provided by the Company.

sections.title: 2. Service Content
body: The Company provides company and service information through the website and receives inquiries and course applications.
Separate membership registration is not required to use the website.

sections.title: 3. User Obligations
body: Users must not misappropriate another person's information or enter false information.
Users may not reproduce, distribute, or commercially use website content without the Company's prior consent.

sections.title: 4. Copyright
body: Copyright in text, images, and materials posted on the website belongs to the Company.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
body: The Company is not liable for service interruption caused by force majeure, such as natural disasters or communication failures.
Information posted on the website is for reference, and specific contract terms are governed by separate consultation and contracts.

sections.title: 6. Jurisdiction
body: Disputes related to these Terms shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the court having jurisdiction over the location of the Company's head office.
